islands.name: Fuscia Village
islands.description: A peaceful village on Dawn Island where Luffy grew up and where his journey as a pirate begins.

pt.name: Vila Fuscia
pt.description: Vila pacata na Dawn Island onde Luffy cresceu e onde sua jornada como pirata começa.

islands.name: Orange Town
islands.description: A coastal town terrorized by the crew of Buggy the Clown.

pt.name: Orange Town
pt.description: Cidade litorânea aterrorizada pelo bando do pirata Buggy, o Palhaço.

islands.name: Syrup Village
islands.description: A coastal village, home to Usopp and Kaya, threatened by Kuro's crew.

pt.name: Syrup Village
pt.description: Vila costeira, lar de Usopp e Kaya, ameaçada pelo bando de Kuro.

islands.name: Baratie
islands.description: A floating restaurant in the middle of the sea, run by chef Zeff.

pt.name: Baratie
pt.description: Restaurante flutuante no meio do mar, comandado pelo chef Zeff.

islands.name: Conomi Islands
islands.description: An archipelago dominated by Arlong's fish-men, home to Nami.

pt.name: Ilhas Conomi
pt.description: Arquipélago dominado pelos homens-peixe de Arlong, lar de Nami.

islands.name: Loguetown
islands.description: The town of the beginning and the end, where Gold Roger was born and executed.

pt.name: Loguetown
pt.description: A cidade do início e do fim, onde Gold Roger nasceu e foi executado.

characterVersions.description: A rubber boy determined to become the Pirate King.

pt.description: Um garoto de borracha determinado a se tornar o Rei dos Piratas.

characterVersions.description: A former pirate hunter recruited by Luffy, who dreams of becoming the world's greatest swordsman.

pt.description: Ex-caçador de piratas recrutado por Luffy, sonha em ser o maior espadachim do mundo.

characterVersions.description: A pirate who ate the Bara Bara no Mi, able to split his own body into pieces.

pt.description: Pirata que comeu a Bara Bara no Mi, capaz de separar o próprio corpo em pedaços.

characterVersions.description: A talented thief and navigator, not yet officially part of the crew.

pt.description: Ladra e navegadora talentosa, ainda não faz parte oficialmente da tripulação.

characterVersions.description: Storyteller and elite sniper from Syrup Village.

pt.description: Contador de histórias e atirador de elite de Syrup Village.

characterVersions.description: Chef at the Baratie, fights using only his legs so as not to hurt his hands.

pt.description: Cozinheiro do Baratie, luta usando apenas as pernas para não machucar as mãos.

characterVersions.description: A fish-man who rules the Conomi Islands and enslaves its inhabitants.

pt.description: Homem-peixe que domina as Ilhas Conomi e escraviza seus habitantes.

characterVersions.description: Free from her debt to Arlong, now the official navigator of the Straw Hats.

pt.description: Livre da dívida com Arlong, agora navegadora oficial dos Chapéus de Palha.

events.title: Luffy confronts Alvida and rescues Coby
events.description: Luffy reveals his Devil Fruit power and frees Coby from Alvida's crew.

pt.title: Luffy enfrenta Alvida e resgata Coby
pt.description: Luffy revela seu poder de fruta do diabo e liberta Coby do bando de Alvida.

events.title: Luffy recruits Zoro
events.description: Luffy frees Zoro, held captive by the Marines, and invites him to join the crew.

pt.title: Luffy recruta Zoro
pt.description: Luffy liberta Zoro, preso pela Marinha, e o convida para a tripulação.

events.title: Showdown with Buggy's crew
events.description: Luffy and Zoro face off against Buggy's crew to free Orange Town.

pt.title: Confronto com o bando de Buggy
pt.description: Luffy e Zoro enfrentam o bando de Buggy para libertar Orange Town.

events.title: Usopp joins the crew
events.description: After the confrontation with Kuro's crew, Usopp boards the Going Merry.

pt.title: Usopp se junta à tripulação
pt.description: Após o confronto com o bando de Kuro, Usopp embarca no Going Merry.

events.title: Duel against Don Krieg
events.description: Sanji and Luffy face Don Krieg's armed fleet in defense of the Baratie.

pt.title: Duelo contra Don Krieg
pt.description: Sanji e Luffy enfrentam a frota armada de Don Krieg em defesa do Baratie.

events.title: Sanji joins the crew
events.description: Sanji leaves the Baratie to sail in search of the All Blue.

pt.title: Sanji se junta à tripulação
pt.description: Sanji deixa o Baratie para navegar em busca do All Blue.

events.title: Battle against Arlong
events.description: Luffy confronts Arlong to free Nami and the village of Cocoyasi.

pt.title: Batalha contra Arlong
pt.description: Luffy enfrenta Arlong para libertar Nami e a vila de Cocoyasi.

events.title: Nami officially joins the crew
events.description: Free from her debt to Arlong, Nami takes her place as the Straw Hats' navigator.

pt.title: Nami se junta oficialmente à tripulação
pt.description: Livre da dívida com Arlong, Nami assume seu lugar como navegadora dos Chapéus de Palha.

events.title: Arrival at Loguetown
events.description: The crew visits the town where Gold Roger was born and executed, the gateway to the Grand Line.

pt.title: Chegada a Loguetown
pt.description: A tripulação visita a cidade onde Gold Roger nasceu e foi executado, a porta de entrada para a Grand Line.
